name: Finance first
description: A support desk whose money questions go past the finance desk.

auditor.description: Keeps a note of every refund.
auditor.instructions: You are told when a refund has gone out. Write one line saying what it was for.

finance-desk.description: Knows the rules for refunds, invoices and tax.
finance-desk.instructions:
You are asked before money moves. Say what the rule is, and what is missing.
A refund above 100 USD needs the order number and the reason.

support.instructions: Help the customer with their order. Look the order up before you answer.

upset-customer.description: The customer is angry or upset.

then.remind: The customer is upset. Apologise once, plainly, before anything else.

wrap-up.description: A run that is taking long is told to finish with what it has.

then.remind: You have taken more than six steps on this request. Answer with what you have, and say plainly what you could not find out.

back-office.description: Where the billing and order systems are reached.

finance.description: Money moving — refunds, invoices, credit, tax.
